result.summary: The page layout is mostly coherent, but there are several visual defects: a nonsensical "-0%" discount badge, inconsistent favorite-button styling between cards, hard-clipped text in the horizontal carousel, and content that is cut off / clipped at the viewport edges without visual affordance.

issues.description: The second card in "Popular right now" shows a promo badge reading "-0%", which represents a zero discount and looks like a data/formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Only render the discount badge when the discount value is greater than 0, and validate the percentage value coming from the API.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, making it look broken and reducing contrast against the light pizza image.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button treatment (e.g. white circle with dark heart plus a subtle shadow) across all restaurant cards so it is legible on any image background.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel the third card is hard-clipped at the screen edge and its title renders as "Trattoria Piccol" with no ellipsis, so it reads as truncated/broken text rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek so the next card is clearly partially visible, and apply text-overflow: ellipsis with a single-line clamp to card titles.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is also clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no fade or partial-chip indication, so users may not realize more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add an edge gradient/fade or ensure chips snap so a partial chip is intentionally visible, indicating horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the fixed bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and metadata are hidden and the image is sliced abruptly right at the nav divider.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the nav bar height so cards can scroll fully clear of the tab bar.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a near-white background while its neighbouring cards use dark imagery, and its "15–25 min" badge sits on a very light area, giving the row an inconsistent, unfinished look.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (consistent background or a subtle overlay/gradient behind badges) so badges stay legible and the row looks uniform.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell, heart/favorite buttons, search icon) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are missing they will be unusable with screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide aria-label / accessibility labels such as "Notifications" and "Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites" for all icon-only buttons.
